patch_description: This hybrid keeps the current implementation’s concave demand component, so moderate-demand direct links and paths still matter, while shifting both signals toward the inspiration program’s direct-demand weighting. It also adopts the inspiration’s stronger discount for paths whose component links already carry direct traffic. Transit-node pressure discourages reliance on busy intermediate nodes, and a slightly stronger degree penalty is intended to keep annealing samples closer to valid topologies. Quadratic terms are generated only for positive-demand OD pairs, so the term count stays below \(n^3\).
